mapper.insert: insert into res_proxy_node_traffic (node_id, stat_time, rx_delta, tx_delta) values (#{nodeId}, #{statTime}, #{rxDelta}, #{txDelta})
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic where node_id = #{nodeId}
select ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id where p.instance_id = #{instanceId}

select p.instance_id as instanceId, ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node p left join res_proxy_node_traffic t on t.node_id = p.id where p.instance_id in #{instanceId} group by p.instance_id
select ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id where p.instance_id is not null
select ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id where p.customer_id is not null

select p.instance_id as instanceId, i.name as instanceName, i.ip as instanceIp, date(t.stat_time) as statDate, ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx, count(distinct p.id) as nodeCount from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id left join res_instance i on p.instance_id = i.id where p.instance_id is not null and t.stat_time >= #{fromTime} group by p.instance_id, i.name, i.ip, date(t.stat_time) order by statDate asc, p.instance_id asc

select p.customer_id as customerId, c.username as username, p.id as nodeId, p.node_name as nodeName, ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id left join mb_customer c on p.customer_id = c.id where p.customer_id is not null and t.stat_time >= #{fromTime} and t.stat_time <= #{toTime} group by p.customer_id, c.username, p.id, p.node_name order by (ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) + ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0)) desc

select p.instance_id as instanceId, i.name as instanceName, i.ip as instanceIp, ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx, count(distinct p.id) as nodeCount from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id left join res_instance i on p.instance_id = i.id where p.instance_id is not null and t.stat_time >= #{fromTime} and t.stat_time <= #{toTime} group by p.instance_id, i.name, i.ip order by (ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) + ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0)) desc
